rules.title: A word must carry a fact, not a temperature
rules.text: The register bans the words that cannot be checked — powerful, seamless, robust, simple, easy, effortless, just, very, mostly — because a reader can neither verify nor act on them; a sentence that needs one has not said what it means.

judgement.question: Does this line use a banned word in its own voice, rather than quoting it as an example or using it for a specific fact?

criteria.true: the document itself uses the word as a hedge or a temperature
criteria.false: it is quoted as a banned example, or it names a measurement, or it means only (`just` the cursor's line)
